scope: Experimental SIM-5 constrained/free-free and multi-domain modal analysis plus single-domain linear-eigenvalue buckling on the Windows x64 Gmsh/CalculiX pipeline.

lanes.acceptance: A density-backed fixed steel cantilever uses consistent mass and frequency bounds; its first mode agrees with the Euler-Bernoulli reference within 18%.
Every returned mode has per-domain digest-verified paginated triangle fields with deterministic maximum-vector normalization and solver mass-normalization provenance.
A free-free solid recovers and diagnoses six rigid-body modes before elastic modes.

evidence.classification: CalculiX omits the six singular modes from field output and numbers the first returned elastic mode as 7

lanes.acceptance: A plate fixture agrees with a declared analytical frequency solution and boundary assumptions.

evidence.analyticalModel: Kirchhoff-Love thin square plate, clamped coefficient 35.99

lanes.acceptance: Coarse, medium, and fine meshes demonstrate stable eigenvalue convergence under declared tolerances.
Explicit bonded/shared multi-domain models preserve modal ownership and coupling behavior.

evidence.fixture: two bonded 50x10x5 mm steel domains forming a 100x10x5 mm cantilever
evidence.interaction: bonded_tie with adjustment none and 0.05 mm position tolerance

lanes.acceptance: A declared compressive preload and eigenvalue factors agree with an Euler-column comparison.
An independent qualified engineer approves the formulations, fixtures, tolerances, assumptions, and exact reviewed commit.
